subject: Contract rhythm & closure cadence — MSA / DPA / Order Form alignment
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@nexatherapeutics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Contract rhythm & closure cadence — MSA / DPA / Order Form alignment

Hi Aisha —

Attaching our initial MSA (Initial_MSA_v1.docx) and proposing a short mutual action plan to align procurement, legal, and security so we can lock a go-live date. High level proposal:

- Parallel review but ordered acceptance: legal review and redlines on MSA + DPA in week 1; sign MSA once commercial terms are agreed; execute DPA as addendum but ideally completed prior to production enablement.
- Order form/SOW must be finalized for your procurement team to issue PO.
- Evidence windows: we can provide SOC 2 report and architecture diagram by the evidence drop date; pen test report timing TBD.

Proposed near-term timeline (flexible):
- Legal redlines returned: by EOD 2028-06-12
- Final commercial SOW/order form: by 2028-06-14
- Signatures (DocuSign): target week of 2028-06-16
- DPA complete and countersigned: by 2028-06-20
- PO issued: by 2028-06-21
- Target production enablement: 2028-07-01

Can you confirm who from Nexa will own legal and procurement on your side, and whether the DPA must be signed before procurement will generate the PO? I copied Kimberly and Rachel (legal and customer success) so we can coordinate the deliverables.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute cross-functional sync if that helps.

— Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: Initial_MSA_v1.docx (DOCX, 412 KB)]

From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@nexatherapeutics.com>

Cc: procurement@nexatherapeutics.com, Privacy Counsel <privacy@lawpartners.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract rhythm & closure cadence — MSA / DPA / Order Form alignment

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the plan and draft. A few immediate notes from our side:

- I've attached our redlines to the MSA (Nexa_redlines_MSA_v1.pdf). Key items: indemnity cap language, data residency clause, and a short SOW reference for usage tiers.
- Our privacy counsel (cc'd) has indicated the DPA is reviewed separately and they typically require DPA execution before any production data is processed. They can do parallel review, but the PO/procurement team often requires a signed DPA as a condition for the final purchase order.
- Procurement needs a price worksheet + final SOW to create the PO. Can you confirm the final order form template and the SOW line items you expect?

We can do parallel legal reviews but procurement will likely hold the PO until DPA is in place. Happy to do the 30-minute sync — can we aim for Thursday morning PT?

Best,
Aisha Kapoor
Senior Program Manager, Vendor Ops | Nexa Therapeutics
aisha.kapoor@nexatherapeutics.com

On Tue, Jun 5, 2028 at 1:42 PM Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@nexatherapeutics.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jordan — appreciate the plan and draft. A few immediate notes from our side:
> 
> - I've attached our redlines to the MSA (Nexa_redlines_MSA_v1.pdf)...

Thanks Aisha — good context. Quick internal readout and proposed sequencing to keep Nexa comfortable and minimize go-live friction:

1) Parallel review (recommended): Redwood legal will accept most commercial redlines and push for clarifying language around indemnity cap and data residency. We'll produce a marked copy by EOD 2028-06-09.
2) DPA handling: Privacy teams can perform parallel review; we are amenable to signing DPA as an addendum at signature time, but we recognize Nexa procurement's preference to have DPA in place before PO. Proposed compromise:
   - Target DPA countersignature by 2028-06-20.
   - We will agree to a conditional PO release pathway: procurement receives final SOW and order form and can prepare PO; final issuance contingent on DPA countersign.
3) Evidence and security artifacts: provide SOC 2 Type II summary and architecture diagram by 2028-06-12; full pen test report is expected the week of 2028-06-26.

Proposed owners for the mutual action plan (MAP):
- Legal (Redwood): Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwood.ai) — lead for MSA redlines
- Privacy (Redwood): Rachel Kim (rachel_kim@redwood.ai) — lead on DPA and privacy Qs
- Procurement (Nexa): Nexa Procurement (procurement@nexatherapeutics.com) — PO issuance
- Program (Nexa): Aisha Kapoor — overall program owner

Next steps I recommend:
- Jordan to circulate a concise MAP with milestone dates and owner assignments (I can help iterate).
- Schedule a 30-minute legal + procurement + security sync on Thu 2028-06-07 (suggest 9:30am PT).

Attaching a basic MAP workbook (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) with columns for owner, milestone, deliverable, due date.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 56 KB)]

- Thu 9:30am PT works for the sync — I'll have procurement and a privacy rep on the call.

Subject: Contract rhythm MAP — refined milestones and owners (v1)

Hi all —

Per today's sync I circulated a refined mutual action plan (attached as Contract_Rhythm_MAP_20280607.pdf) and laid out milestone dates so procurement and legal know the gating path. Summary below — please confirm acceptance or call out conflicts by EOD Friday:

Milestone cadence (v1):
- 2028-06-09: Redwood returns marked MSA incorporating Nexa redlines
- 2028-06-12: Nexa to confirm final commercial SOW/order form (owner: Aisha / procurement)
- 2028-06-16: Target DocuSign send for MSA + Order Form (owner: Jordan)
- 2028-06-20: DPA countersignature target (owner: Rachel / Nexa Privacy Counsel)
- 2028-06-21: Procurement issues PO (owner: procurement@nexatherapeutics.com) — PO issuance contingent on DPA countersign as discussed
- 2028-07-01: Target production enablement / go-live (owner: Jordan / CS)

DocuSign envelope will include the MSA and Order Form; DPA will be attached as an addendum and routed for parallel countersignature. Link for signing will be posted to the shared drive and emailed to procurement and billing contacts.

DocuSign for envelope (preview): https://docusign.com/txn/abc123-contract-nexa

If there are no objections I will prepare the DocuSign bundle Monday morning and send it to the legal and procurement contacts.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
